name: Franchise Opportunity API
description: Identify, score, and produce due-diligence briefs for restaurant/franchise expansion and investment. /generate-investment-brief returns franchise_fit_score, market_demand_score, competition_intensity, estimated_startup_cost, payback_period_estimate, location_risks, and an opportunity_summary in one call. Built for investor, franchise-development, and advisory agents.

pricing_model.free_tier: GET / discovery is free; new keys include $5 trial credit.

useCases: Assess whether a fast-casual brand is a fit for the Austin market.
Compare Austin, Nashville, and Denver for a franchise rollout.
Score a specific storefront's fit and surface location risks.
Produce a full investment due-diligence brief with payback estimate.

agentUseCases.workflow: Compare markets, score the top site, then generate-investment-brief for the committee.
Screen inbound territories at scale with analyze-franchise-opportunity.
Bundle a paid due-diligence brief as a fixed-fee deliverable.

compliance: GDPR: business-data-focused; ensure lawful basis where personal data appears

human_approval_required._note: All endpoints are analysis/advisory and output is explicitly not financial advice; no money is moved and no outward-facing action is taken, so no execution gate is required.

chain_to.reason: Assess an existing unit's upside before acquiring.
Map the competitive set around a candidate site.
Gauge brand reputation in the target market.

examplePrompts: Is this fast-casual brand a good fit for Austin?
Compare Austin, Nashville, and Denver for a new franchise unit.
Score this storefront on South Lamar for the brand and list the risks.
Give me a full investment brief with startup cost and payback period.
